newsitem.title: JAPAN: France to try to meet 1999 EMU deadline -- Arthuis.
newsitem.headline: France to try to meet 1999 EMU deadline -- Arthuis.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Monday that France will make efforts to meet the requirements to join the European Union's economic and monetary union by the 1999 deadline, a Japanese Finance Mimistry official told reporters.
He also welcomed Japan's efforts on financial reform.

The official said Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told Arthuis on Monday afternoon that swift implementation of Japan's five-year plan for financial reform, announced last week, would contribute to global economic stability.
Mitsuzuka said the European Union's move towards economic union would create a third large currency region, which would also lead to global economic stability, the official said.
Arthuis said other European nations were also making efforts to meet the EMU requirements.
The official briefed reporters after Arthuis and Mitsuzuka met to discuss the two nations' economies as well as the global economy and finance.
Arthuis and Mitsuzuka pledged that France and Japan will work for financial restructuring as well as make efforts to trim their nations' deficits, the official said.
